name: PubMed offline-knowledge agent gate v4
description: End-to-end GLM tool-use gate for ordinary literature questions against the registered PubMed 2026 baseline. Version 4 retains the v3 prompts and uses wording-tolerant factual alternatives derived from verified abstract text.

cases.prompt: Using our offline library, what did the 2012 paper about a programmable dual-RNA-guided DNA endonuclease report about how Cas9 cuts DNA and its potential use?

alternatives: double stranded breaks in target DNA
HNH nuclease domain cleaves the complementary strand
HNH domain cuts the complementary strand
RuvC like domain cleaves the noncomplementary strand
RuvC domain cuts the noncomplementary strand

cases.prompt: Using our offline library, summarize what the obese and lean twin study found about a core gut microbiome.

alternatives: core microbiome at the gene level
functional core rather than organismal lineage
altered representation of bacterial genes and metabolic pathways

cases.prompt: Using our offline library, what limitations and promising technologies did the review titled 'Amyloid Beta and Tau as Alzheimer's Disease Blood Biomarkers: Promise From New Technologies' identify?

alternatives: lower than levels in cerebrospinal fluid
